long_biography.plain_text:
IVC gave Balcaen a second flooring platform after his years at Balta. Founded in Belgium in 1997, it manufactured sheet vinyl and luxury vinyl tile for European and American markets. Balcaen served as chief executive and later chairman, remaining its primary shareholder until Mohawk Industries acquired the business in 2015.

He had begun at Balta, the carpet group founded by his father, and rose to chief executive and chairman before its sale. He then founded Baltisse to redeploy industrial proceeds across private equity, real estate and capital markets. As executive chairman, he brings operating experience to investments rather than managing each portfolio company day to day. He also represents Baltisse as a non-executive director of insulation manufacturer Recticel.
